raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and improved glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body resistance A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 20m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body resistance B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body resistance A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x35..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 22m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body resistance B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x25..35 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full body resistance A - progression":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..50 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Steady cardio & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 30m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cat_cow 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body resistance B - progression":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..40 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Recovery & testing":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Low impact cardio":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 25m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body mixed":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength & Intensity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "HIIT low impact":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 10m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          rowing 10m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper strength+hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Moderate cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 30m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower strength+power":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Interval cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 6x2m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Deload & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Low impact steady cardio":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 30m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body light":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Conditioning & Maintenance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength full":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "HIIT & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower & conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 10:

        warmup:

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Endurance cardio":

      DAY Friday training 65m "Legs & metabolic":

    WEEK 11:

    WEEK 12:
